---
title: "Water Quality Monitoring for `r params$park_full`: `r params$current_year` Network Data Report"
output: 
  html_document:
    css: www/styles.css

params:
  # park: "ISRO" # default
  # park_full: "Isle Royale National Park" # default
  park: "SACN" # default
  park_full: "St. Croix National Scenic Riverway" # default
  current_year: 2025
  discharge_date: "2025-12-01"
  scope: "full"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, 
                      message = FALSE, 
                      warning = FALSE)
```

```{r source, include=FALSE}
# source("WaterQuality_AnnualReport_compile.R")
sys.source("WaterQuality_AnnualReport_compile.R", envir = knitr::knit_global())
```

```{r data, include=FALSE}
# loading data
df <- wqp_data |> 
  dplyr::filter(Park == params$park)

# selecting park type 
type <- park_type[params$park]

# getting site names 
if(type == "lake"){
  
  sites <- df |> 
    dplyr::distinct(MonitoringLocationName_Long) |> 
    dplyr::arrange(MonitoringLocationName_Long) |> 
    dplyr::pull() 
  
} else{
  
  # note: this chunk of code will not work if more river parks are selected. 
  site_order <- c("CCC Bridge", "Leonards", "Earl", "Namekagon Trail", "Norway Point",
                  "Highway 70", "Nevers Dam", "Osceola")
  
  sites <- df  |> 
  dplyr::mutate(MonitoringLocationName_Long = factor(MonitoringLocationName_Long,
                                                     levels = site_order)) |> 
  dplyr::distinct(MonitoringLocationName_Long) |> 
  dplyr::arrange(MonitoringLocationName_Long) |> 
  dplyr::pull()
}

# selecting params
if(type == "lake"){
  selected_params <- lake_param
} else{
  selected_params <- river_param
}
```

## Overview {.tabset}
This report contains all parameter collected at sites in `r params$park_full` in `r params$current_year`.

<h1>Map of `r params$park`</h1>
```{r map, results='asis'}
map_data <- prep_map(df)

plot_map(df = map_data,
         type = type)

if(type == "river"){
  cat("<p><strong>Figure 1. </strong>Water quality sampling locations (blue) for", params$park, ". Green markers indicate sites where average daily stream flow is measured by the U.S. Geological Survey (USGS). Click on the dots to see site names. Discharge (flow) at the USGS gauge on the Namekagon River at Leonards, WI (USGS-05331833) is shown in water quality summaries for Leonards, Earl, and Namekagon Trail. Discharge at the USGS gauge on the St. Croix River near Danbury, WI (USGS-05333500) is shown in water quality summaries for CCC Bridge, Norway Point, and Highway 70. Discharge at the USGS gauge on the St. Croix River at St. Croix Falls, WI (USGS-05340500) is shown in water quality summaries for Nevers Dam and Osceola.\n\n")
  
} else{

  cat("<p><strong>Figure 1. </strong>Water quality sampling locations (blue) for", params$park,". Click on the dots to see site names.\n\n")

}

  cat("<br><br>")
```

### Site Summaries {.tabset}

```{r site-tabs, results='asis', fig.width=14, fig.height=20, out.width='100%'}
for(site in sites){
  
  # Create tab for site
  cat("#### ", site, "\n\n")

  # subsetting site data 
  site_data <- df |> 
    dplyr::filter(MonitoringLocationName_Long == site)
  
  # Boxplots ----
  boxplot_data <- prep_boxplot(df = site_data,
                               scope = params$scope,
                               type = type)
  
  bp <- plot_boxplot(df = boxplot_data)
  
  print(bp)
  
  cat("<br><br>")
  
  cat("<p><strong>Figure 2. </strong>Boxplots showing ", params$current_year," data (green) compared to all data (blue) from previous years collected at", site, ". The boxplots show the median (center line) and 25th and 75th percentiles (box edges), with whiskers (1.5x Interquartile Range) and outliers (points).\n\n")
  
  cat("<br><br>")
  
  # Timeseries ----
  timeseriesdata <- prep_timeseries(df = site_data,
                                    scope = params$scope,
                                    type = type)
  
  ts <- plot_timeseries(current = timeseriesdata$current,
                        historic = timeseriesdata$historic)
  
  print(ts)
  
  cat("<br><br>")
  
  if(type == "river"){
    
  cat("<p><strong>Figure 3. </strong>Time series showing monthly surface measurements in the upper 2 m of the water column for ", site, ". The blue bands represent the total range (minimum and maximum) and 95% and 50% ranges of historic values ( 2006 - ", as.numeric(params$current_year) - 1, ") collected for each month. The blue line is the median historic value collected for each month. The black points are the ", params$current_year, " values collected during each month, except for discharge, which represents average monthly values of daily means. For data collected by sond, means were calculated and plotted when two values were collected within the upper 2 m of the water column; median was calculated and plotted when three or more measurements were collected.\n\n")
    
  } else {
    
    cat("<p><strong>Figure 3. </strong>Time series showing monthly surface measurements in the upper 2 m of the water column for ", site, ". The blue bands represent the total range (minimum and maximum) and 95% and 50% ranges of historic values (2006-", as.numeric(params$current_year) - 1, ") collected for each month. The blue line is the median historic value collected for each month. The black points are the ", params$current_year, " values collected during each month. For data collected by sond, means were calculated and plotted when two values were collected within the upper 2 m of the water column; medians were calculated and plotted when three or more measurements were collected.\n\n")
    
  }
  
  cat("<br><br>")
  
  # Summary Table ----
  table_data <- prep_table(df = site_data,
                           scope = params$scope,
                           type = type)
  
  table <- create_table(table_data)
    
  cat("<p><strong>Table 1. </strong>Summary statistics (minimum, median, maximum, and standard deviation) for historic (2006-", as.numeric(current_year) - 1, ") and current year (", current_year, ") data.\n\n")

  
  print_table(table)
  
  cat("<br><br>")

  # Depth Profile
  profile_data <- prep_profiles(df = site_data,
                                scope = params$scope,
                                type = type)
  
  # run if lake park, skip if not
  if(!is.null(profile_data)){
    
  depth_profiles <- plot_depthprofile(current = profile_data$current,
                                      historic = profile_data$historic,
                                      scope = params$scope)
  
  print(depth_profiles)
  
  cat("<br><br>")
  
  cat("<p><strong>Figure 4. </strong>Depth profiles plots of data collected by sond for ", current_year,". The shaded areas represent the minimum and maximum values recorded at each depth at ", site, " from 2006 - ", as.numeric(params$current_year) - 1, ". \n\n")
  }
  
  cat("\n\n")
}
```
